entries.en: Narujj Boh requests your aid in preventing the creation of a new wave of tempered.
entries.fr: Narujj Boh a une tâche à vous confier.
entries.ja: 灰の陣営のナルジ・ボーは、冒険者に頼みがあるようだ。
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Appalled at the boldness of his demented kin and the success of their kidnapping efforts, Narujj Boh bids you assist the Brotherhood in preventing the ranks of the tempered from growing ever more numerous. You are to ambush Flamefang ravagers in the Zanr'ak encampment, and seize from them the cage keys they hold.

entries.en: You have freed the captives from the Amalj'aa cages. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Narujj Boh.

entries.en: Narujj Boh is impressed with the courage and ability you displayed in plucking the captives straight from the jaws of the Flamefangs. As you continue to prove your worth as an ally, the Brotherhood warrior is encouraged to look to his own training.
entries.fr: Narujj Boh semble très impressionné par votre mission. Il vous affirme sa volonté de ne pas relâcher ses efforts pour être lui aussi à la hauteur. Restez à l'écoute des besoins des Amalj'aa de la Ligue des cendres.
entries.ja: ナルジ・ボーに報告した。冒険者の鮮やかな手並みに感嘆するナルジ・ボー。冒険者に負けないよう、己を鍛え直すと彼は語った。またの機会に協力しよう。

entries.en: Though we work tirelessly to sabotage the plans of the Flamefangs, we cannot prevent every raid or ambush. The flow of kidnapping victims into Zahar'ak has been endless of late...
entries.fr: Salutations, puissant guerri. Leurs activités, les Crocs de Feu intensifient. Les enlèvements, ils multiplient. Sérieuse, la situation est.
entries.ja:
「炎牙衆」の動きが活発化しているのをご存じか？
奴らの手にかかり、拐われる者が近頃は後を絶たぬ。
由々しき事態と言えようぞ。

entries.en: Our demented kin brazenly stalk the lands around Camp Drybone and Little Ala Mhigo, snatching travelers from the roads be it dusk or dawn, or under the unblinking glare of the midday sun.
entries.fr: Sans craindre d'être aperçus, leurs crimes ils commettent au grand jour. Près des Os desséchés et de Petite Ala Mhigo, des humains ils enlèvent au grand jour.
entries.ja:
楚囚南冠。
奴ら、キャンプ・ドライボーンやリトルアラミゴ周辺で、
人目もはばからず人拐いをしている模様。

entries.en: The Flamefangs have grown so adept at their detestable trade that they are forced to take their prisoners first to the Zanr'ak encampment, there to be kept in makeshift cages until Ifrit's clergy are ready to receive them.
entries.fr: De sinistres histoires, nos éclaireurs rapportent. Des , ils promènent au grand jour. Leurs prises, ils y placent.

entries.en: Our latest reconnaissance informs us that Zanr'ak is host to a group of captives even as we speak. If we do not act swiftly, the ranks of the tempered will soon welcome a new wave of recruits.
entries.fr: D'être emmenés à Zahar'ak, ces prisonniers risquent sans une intervention de notre groupe. Les empêcher de recruter de nouveaux épurés, nous devons !
entries.ja:
このまま指をくわえておれば、
捕虜たちはザハラク戦陣へ送られることとなろう。
「焼かれし者」を増やさぬため、捕虜を解き放つべし！

entries.en: Prying those prizes from the very maw of the Flamefangs was no simple task. It is no mystery to me why the warleader chose to place his trust in you.
entries.fr: Une très bonne action, tu as effectuée en libérant les prisonniers. L'estime que notre chef a pour toi, je comprends mieux. Remarquables, tes faits d'armes sont.
entries.ja:
囚われし者たちを解放、まことに大儀であった。
流石は長も認める一流の武人、頼りになるものよ。
……まさしく惚れ惚れするような手並みなり。
